environment.after: commit efd5ee5 plus the audit O13 fix (transport steps and the S_N CMFD coarse solve)
environment.timing: best of 3 identical runs, one process per configuration, sequential; references 1 run
environment.note: Node shared but lightly loaded (load average about 5 on 256 cores).

setup.inf: tests/verification/test_kinetics_reference.py medium (2x2 cells, reflective, 1 group, 6 families): sigma_a lowered by 0.002 $ at t=0+, backward Euler, dt 0.05 s to 4 s; default steady state. Reference: diffusion TransientSolver at tol_step 1e-12, which every model reproduces on this medium (S_N to its steady tolerance, about 5e-7).
setup.bl20: test_sdpn_symmetric._bl_problem(20): 1 group, vacuum on the high x/y faces (coupled Marshak for SDP3, BiCGStab), fuel sigma_a * 0.995 for t > 0, beta 0.0065, lambda 0.08, v 2.2e5; dt 0.01 s to 0.5 s; steady tol_k 1e-10, tol_source 1e-9 (the O7 setup).
setup.biblis2: build_biblis(2), 34x34, 2 groups, vacuum in-plane; material 1 thermal sigma_a * 0.997 for t > 0; beta 0.0065, lambda 0.08, v 1.25e7/2.5e5; dt 0.01 s to 0.2 s; steady as bl20 (the O7 setup).
setup.sn20: the bl20 core with vacuum on every face, Cartesian S_N (n_polar 2, n_azi 4, default acceleration, CMFD step acceleration), to 0.2 s. Reference: the after-fix run at tol_step 1e-10.
setup.steps_unchanged: steps whose power changed by less than 1e-14
setup.sn_note: The S_N after-fix rows include the amplitude test in the CMFD coarse fixed point. Without it the 1e-10 run stalled (source change 5.6e-12, amplitude error 7.2e-10) and 1e-9 took 7382 transport sweeps; with it, 978 and 946.
